senses.definition: Appearing to be foreign; strange, unfamiliar.
senses.sourceDefinition: Appearing to be foreign; strange, unfamiliar.
senses.example: Roast beef and plum pudding are also held in superstitious veneration, and port and sherry maintain their grounds as the only true English wines; all others being considered vile outlandish beverages.

senses.definition: Greatly different from common experience; bizarre, outrageous, strange.
senses.sourceDefinition: Greatly different from common experience; bizarre, outrageous, strange.
senses.example: The rock star wore black with outlandish pink and green spiked hair.

senses.definition: Of a place: far away from where most people are located; in the middle of nowhere, out of the way, remote.
senses.sourceDefinition: Of a place: far away from where most people are located; in the middle of nowhere, out of the way, remote.

groups.definition: Looking or behaving in a way that is very strange, unusual, or shocking.
groups.usageNote: Can describe people, things, or ideas that seem completely foreign or out of the ordinary.

groups.definition: Located in a remote place far away from civilization.
groups.usageNote: Often used in a derogatory way to describe an isolated location.
